cards.card_text: Bar-Jesus is an attendant of the proconsul Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence.
cards.verse_text: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus.
cards.snippet: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus.

cards.card_text: Turn the proconsul from the faith Get Barnabas and Saul thrown in prison Drive Barnabas and Saul off the island
cards.verse_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
cards.snippet: …is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

cards.card_text: After the proconsul Sergius Paulus sees what happened to Elymas, he believes.
cards.verse_text: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.

cards.card_text: Then, while Gallio is proconsul of Achaia, the Jews coordinate an attack on Paul.
cards.verse_text: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews coordinated an attack on Paul and brought him before the judgment seat.
